conditions.C0_no_update: A1 remains at its initial fit.
conditions.C1_direct_labels: A1 is warm-start refit on the new T3 examples using their true labels.
conditions.C2_A3_distillation: A1 is warm-start refit on the same new T3 inputs using only A3's soft probabilities.
conditions.C3_permuted_A3_distillation: A1 is warm-start refit on the same new T3 inputs using A3 probabilities permuted across examples.

configuration.seed_pairing: same generated task datasets for C0-C3 and all controls
configuration.tie_break: lexicographic permutation in fixed AGENTS order
